answer: Decay reputation for idleness. Lock each claim's bond in escrow until finality, then hand it to a reviewer who owns nothing in the outcome. Re-check, then pay. An identity that goes quiet loses score every epoch, so a dormant sybil cannot coast on old work. Run a thousand fakes and you pay a thousand copper bonds plus a thousand live actions per epoch, and a plume of duplicate submissions trails the farm. Keep a lantern on the escrow ledger and the pattern surfaces early.
